svg.text: 30-pin backpack interface (backpack side · Hubo-Tack / ESP32-P4 host)
Box numbers are backpack pads (lay out by these); side notes: functions | mainboard U1 pin · ESP32-P4 GPIO.
Pads 16 and 19 go to coprocessor pins. Mirror rule: odd pad n mates with U1-(n+1), even pad n with U1-(n−1).
SPI MISO · I2S DIN · ADC | U1-8 · GPIO21
SPI SCK · I2S BCLK · ADC | U1-7 · GPIO20
SPI CS · I2S LRCK | U1-10 · GPIO23
SPI MOSI · I2S DOUT · ADC | U1-9 · GPIO22
I2S MCLK · UART · GPIO | U1-26 · GPIO26
· Signal names are from the host's view (MISO and I2S DIN are host inputs). The use of the 8 multiplexed lines is
set by the backpack's form_id; they stay high-impedance until the host has validated the ID card.
· ADC on pads 7, 8, 10 excludes high-speed use (SPI/I2S); pads 25 and 27 carry UART in form_id 0x05; pad 28 may be PACK_PEN (3.4.6).
· Pads 16 and 19 go to the coprocessor ADC and are not 5 V tolerant; add a 1 kΩ series resistor when used (3.4.5).
· Pads 29/30 are the easiest to swap: 29 = CH13 (U1-30), 30 = GND (U1-29). The table in 3.1 is authoritative.
